generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Before and after GPS Photographs shall be submitted
Bidders are bond the guidelines / instructions issued time to from the government
Final bill will be admitted only after the submission of 3rd party report handing over certificate and completion report
If any date in the tender time table is government holidays, nest working date will be considered
Corrigendums / modifications / correction if any will be published in the website only
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The Employer reserves the rights to reject any of all tenders without assigning any reason
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tenderer shall have valid class - IV KPWD
In any TWO financial year out of last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 Turn over Certificate Certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number compulsory
As prime contractor at least one similar work such as of value not less than 50 percentage of amount put tender last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26not below rank of Executive Engineer
Assessed available tender capacity computed as per the formula in section 3.6
I have submitted the tender after reading the terms and conditions as per the bid documents. submit the bidders declaration on a letterhead.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Rejuvanation & Repairs to OHT at Ribanpalli, Buragapalli, Madana, Neelahalli, Murganoor Village in Sedam Taluka under EAP

itemList.description: WORK No. 1 :  Rejuvenation & Repairs to OHT at Ribanpalli Village in Sedam Taluka  Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all super structures of building, road works, water works, irrigation works & super structure works of bridges upto 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, labour, usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (For railing posts, hand rail & stair steps) [Com-SR Vol-I I.No.2.5.2, Pg.16]

Food grade water proofing membrane: Providing and laying water proofing treatment to water tanks & liquid retaining structures with two component acrylic polymer modified cementitious waterproofing membrane with minimum elongation of 50% applied @ 1.5 kg/m² for internal side waterproofing in two layers with waiting period of 4-6 hrs per layer and food grade epoxy coating in two coats certified by CFTRI Mysuru, including surface preparation completely as per specification. (Side wall & bottom slab) [Com-SR Vol-I I.No.15.6, Pg.150]

Ladder inside the container: Providing anodized aluminium ladder using 65mm x 32mm x 3.0mm 'C' section for ladder side channel x 25mm dia. flutal pipe for rungs at 250mm c/c, ladder fixed at an angle of 70 to horizontal including necessary 25mm dia. G.I. shutters with G.I. fasteners for bracing the ladder to the tank walls, with necessary (M-15) bed for embedding the ladder bottom, complete. [Com-SR Vol-V I.No.7.12.1, Pg.88]

Providing and fixing MS inspection door of size 60 cm x 60 cm including MS frame made of 50x50x6mm angle, shutters made of 3mm thick MS sheets, with hinges, locking arrangements at top etc. including painting with anticorrosive approved paint, complete including all lead and lifts. [Com-SR Vol-V I.No.7.3, Pg.85]

Finishing walls with water proofing cement paint of required shade: Old work (one coat applied @ 2.20 kg/10 m²) over priming coat of primer applied @ 0.80 l/10 m², including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications. (Dome, ring beams, walls, walkway, columns, braces, staircase, facia) [Com-SR 2023-24 Vol-II I.No.8.72.1, Pg.52]

Providing plastering in CM 1:3 after removing old plaster of existing RCC over head tank, including smooth finishing, minimum 2% approved water proofing compound, curing, scaffolding and giving satisfactory water proof testing, complete with all lead & lifts, for side walls, shell portions, bottom dome, bottom slab and ribs: 12mm thick for exposed surfaces, 9.0 to 12.0 m staging. [Com-SR 2021-22 I.No.18.3, Pg.113]

Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete PCC 1:2:4 using 40 mm aggregate for levelling course (flagging concrete around OHT), machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, formwork, materials, labour, machinery, curing, complete as per technical specifications. [Com-SR Vol-V I.No.1.3, Pg.107]

Providing and fixing RCC finial and ventilators as per approved design and specifications with form works and protected with wire mesh; plinth of RCC circular pillars and canopy with ornamental finish at top; first 22.5 cm height covered with RCC panelling as per drawings, with all lead and lifts, excluding reinforcement steel. [Com-SR 2023-24 Vol-V I.No.7.2, Pg.85]

PART-B : CHAIN LINK FENCING  Earth work excavation for foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing/levelling the excavated earth within 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m, complete. (For angle iron posts) [Com-SR 2023-24 Vol-I I.No.1.14.1]

Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete M10 (1:3:6) using 20 mm and down graded crushed coarse aggregates for levelling course for all works in foundation, machine mixed, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, materials, labour, machinery, curing, complete. (Footing for angle posts) [Com-SR 2023-24 Vol-I I.No.2.1.4, Pg.15]

Supplying at site angle iron post & strut of required size (100x100x6 mm @ 14.90 kg/m) including bottom to be split and bent at right angle in opposite direction for 10 cm length and drilling holes upto 10 mm dia. etc., complete. [Com-SR 2023-24 Vol-II I.No.11.57.2, Pg.95]

Providing and fixing G.I. chain link fabric fencing of required width in mesh size 50x50 mm (G.I. wire 4 mm dia.) including strengthening with 2 mm dia wire or nuts, bolts and washers as required, complete as per direction of Engineer-in-charge. [Com-SR 2023-24 Vol-II I.No.11.58, Pg.95]
Providing and fixing locking arrangements (gate with lock), complete. [PWD SR 2018-19 P.No.XIV I.No.397]
